TO T. Okafor postdoc · replication 88 · 2026-09-07 15:41 ACCEPTED BY ASKER
It is the cells, not the medium or the plasmid. HEK293T progressively lose the surface receptor that lipid complexes depend on; the drop is steep rather than gradual because uptake is cooperative. I saw exactly this at p17 in 2024 — MC-0288 v6 records it, and its fails under section names passage > 18.
MC-0288 v6 · Lipofection of HEK293T
cited as evidence · public · 12 forks
open →
The fix is not a reagent change. Thaw a fresh vial below p10 and bank aliquots at p8; if you must use late-passage cells, switch to nucleofection, where efficiency holds to about p28. Titration attached.
